blocking_issues.description: COPY go.mod go.sum ./ fails at docker build time — go.sum does not exist in the git tree. Pure stdlib Go module (zero external deps) does not generate go.sum via `go mod tidy`. Docker COPY with a listed filename that is absent errors with '/go.sum: not found'. Confirmed via `docker build --no-cache` → ERROR: failed to solve: /go.sum: not found.
fix_options: Option A (preferred): Commit an empty go.sum file: `touch apps/api-gateway-go/go.sum && git add apps/api-gateway-go/go.sum && git commit -m 'fix(api-gateway-go): AC-1 — add empty go.sum for stdlib-only module Dockerfile layer cache'`

Option B: Change Dockerfile line 8 to `COPY go.mod ./` (remove go.sum from COPY), and remove `RUN go mod download` line 9 (no-op for stdlib). Then `git commit -m 'fix(api-gateway-go): AC-1 — Dockerfile stdlib-only module has no go.sum'`
